# Flit (flit-physics)

> Tiny sphere-physics engine for three.js games and demos: gravity, impulse
> collisions, fixed-point LUT friction, voxel-walk raycasts, and a Morton
> spatial-hash broadphase. TypeScript, CPU, single-threaded, zero native
> dependencies. Ships an MCP server and an agent skill so coding agents can
> wire physics into a scene themselves.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/brashler/Flit/blob/main/README.md): install, usage, benchmarks, agent entry points
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/brashler/Flit/blob/main/skills/flit/SKILL.md): 30-second three.js integration recipe, MCP usage, contributor rules
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/brashler/Flit/blob/main/AGENTS.md): repo-level agent instructions
- [Changelog](https://github.com/brashler/Flit/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
- [Third-party notices](https://github.com/brashler/Flit/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md): FLANN (BSD-2) and other provenance

## Reference

- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/flit-physics): `npm i flit-physics`
- [Demo scene](https://github.com/brashler/Flit/blob/main/demo/main.ts): the proven InstancedMesh integration pattern
- [MCP server](https://github.com/brashler/Flit/blob/main/mcp/server.ts): stdio MCP tools (`flit_spawn`, `flit_step`, `flit_state`, `flit_raycast`, ...)
- [Open issue brief](https://github.com/brashler/Flit/blob/main/docs/issues/001-settled-pile-performance.md): settled-pile solver cost, help wanted
